title: Jzzhu and Chocolate
statementMd:
Jzzhu has a big rectangular chocolate bar that consists of $*n* × *m*$ unit squares. He wants to cut this bar exactly $*k*$ times. Each cut must meet the following requirements:

- each cut should be straight (horizontal or vertical);
- each cut should go along edges of unit squares (it is prohibited to divide any unit chocolate square with cut);
- each cut should go inside the whole chocolate bar, and all cuts must be distinct.

The picture below shows a possible way to cut a $5 × 6$ chocolate for $5$ times.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/924edb5ed617b68cd5f8115d9cad4b70f30b0f59.png)

Imagine Jzzhu have made $*k*$ cuts and the big chocolate is splitted into several pieces. Consider the smallest (by area) piece of the chocolate, Jzzhu wants this piece to be as large as possible. What is the maximum possible area of smallest piece he can get with exactly $*k*$ cuts? The area of a chocolate piece is the number of unit squares in it.

## Input

A single line contains three integers $*n*, *m*, *k*$ $(1 ≤ *n*, *m* ≤ 10^{9}; 1 ≤ *k* ≤ 2·10^{9})$.

## Output

Output a single integer representing the answer. If it is impossible to cut the big chocolate $*k*$ times, print `-1`.

## Note

In the first sample, Jzzhu can cut the chocolate following the picture below:

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/d63ecc29dce25c2d621113c99e8901b660b36ef6.png)

In the second sample the optimal division looks like this:

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/324377ce2dde5cc5c01aa15a2b9b5aa19ea5fd1c.png)

In the third sample, it's impossible to cut a $2 × 3$ chocolate $4$ times.
statementZhMd:
Jzzhu 有一块由 $*n* × *m*$ 个单位正方形组成的大矩形巧克力。他想将这块巧克力恰好切割 $*k*$ 次。每次切割必须满足以下要求：

- 每次切割都必须是直线（水平或垂直）；
- 每次切割都必须沿着单位正方形的边进行（禁止将任何一个单位巧克力正方形切开）；
- 每次切割都必须位于整块巧克力内部，并且所有切割线必须互不相同。

下图展示了将一块 $5 × 6$ 的巧克力切割 $5$ 次的一种可行方案。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/924edb5ed617b68cd5f8115d9cad4b70f30b0f59.png)

假设 Jzzhu 已经完成了 $*k*$ 次切割，大块巧克力被分成了若干块。考虑其中面积最小的巧克力块，Jzzhu 希望让这块巧克力尽可能大。恰好切割 $*k*$ 次时，最小巧克力块的面积可能达到的最大值是多少？巧克力块的面积等于其中单位正方形的数量。

## 输入格式

一行包含三个整数 $*n*, *m*, *k*$ $(1 ≤ *n*, *m* ≤ 10^{9}; 1 ≤ *k* ≤ 2·10^{9})$。

## 输出格式

输出一个整数，表示答案。如果无法将大块巧克力切割 $*k*$ 次，输出 `-1`。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，Jzzhu 可以按照下图所示的方式切割巧克力：

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/d63ecc29dce25c2d621113c99e8901b660b36ef6.png)

在第二个样例中，最优的切割方式如下图所示：

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/324377ce2dde5cc5c01aa15a2b9b5aa19ea5fd1c.png)

在第三个样例中，不可能将一块 $2 × 3$ 的巧克力切割 $4$ 次。
